title: Materials Around Us
text:
Wood is a common material in many homes. It feels warm and smooth when you touch it. Some tables are made of wood. Glass is different. It feels cold and hard, and it is easy to see through.

Wool is soft and warm. Many people wear wool sweaters in winter. Stone is very hard and heavy. Builders use stone to make strong walls.

questions.text: What does wood feel like when you touch it?
What do builders use stone to make?
Which material would most likely keep you warm in winter?
Why are stone walls a good choice for a house?
options: They are easy to see through

vocabulary.definition: having a flat surface with no rough parts
able to hold a lot of weight or pressure

paragraph_translations: Ahşap birçok evde yaygın bir malzemedir. Dokunduğunuzda sıcak ve pürüzsüz hissettirir. Bazı masalar ahşaptan yapılır. Cam farklıdır. Soğuk ve serttir ve içinden görmesi kolaydır.
Yün yumuşak ve sıcaktır. Birçok insan kışın yün kazak giyer. Taş çok serttir ve ağırdır. İnşaatçılar sağlam duvarlar yapmak için taşı kullanır.
